keyPoints: Pratishat ka matlab prati sau — 45% = 45/100 = 0.45; kisi sankhya ka x% = (x/100) x sankhya.
Bhinn/dashamlav ko pratishat me badalne ke liye 100 se guna karo: 3/4 = 75%, 0.6 = 60% — aur pratishat ko wapas bhinn me: 25% = 1/4.
Laabh = vikray moolya - kray moolya; haani = kray moolya - vikray moolya — laabh-haani hamesha kray moolya par nikaalte hain, jo dukandaar ki lagat hai.
Laabh% = (laabh ÷ kray moolya) x 100; 200 ki cheez 250 me bechne par laabh% = 50/200 x 100 = 25%.
Saadha byaj = (mooldhan x dar x samay) ÷ 100 — 1000 rupaye 5% par 2 saal me byaj = 100 rupaye — dar hamesha prati varsh hota hai, samay varshon me lo.
Mishradhan = mooldhan + byaj; chhoot ke baad vikray moolya = ankit moolya - chhoot.
Aam galti: laabh% vikray moolya par nikalna — hamesha kray moolya (lagat) par nikaalo.
